RequestId.description: The gateway's request ID (UUIDv7), also the attempt ID of a root request.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait; only a cooling-down route sends it.

ShouldRetryFalse.description: Permanent refusals (unsupported capability, budget, price or token-reservation denials) tell SDKs not to retry.

OpenAiBadGateway.description: The provider was unavailable or returned an invalid or incomplete response

OpenAiBadRequest.description: Invalid request (the closed field set, a bound, a type) or, for the non-generation workloads, an explicit unsupported_capability; error.code tells them apart

OpenAiNotFound.description: The model does not exist or is not available to this key and workspace (model_not_found)

OpenAiNotImplemented.description: A capability no registered deployment supports (unsupported_capability); permanent

OpenAiPayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route's cap. A declared Content-Length over the cap is refused by the body-limit layer with the plain text `length limit exceeded`, before any handler runs; a streamed body is refused by the handler with the shared JSON error: type invalid_request_error, code payload_too_large, message Request body too large.

OpenAiTooManyRequests.description: Rate or concurrency limit (rate_limit_error), or a permanent budget, unresolved-usage or token-reservation denial (x-should-retry: false)

OpenAiUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unknown, revoked or no-longer-valid inference key (always authentication_error)

OpenAiUnavailable.description: Authentication, catalog or accounting storage unavailable, provider configuration unavailable, an unbounded price, or every route cooling down (Retry-After)

AnthropicErrorEnvelope.description: Anthropic-shaped /v1/messages error (protocols/messages.rs). It carries NO gateway machine code: unsupported_capability, budget_exceeded and the rest cannot be told apart except by their message.

AnthropicErrorType.description: Anthropic error.type. Anthropic's shape has no machine code, so a budget denial is a rate_limit_error distinguishable only by its message.

oneOf.description: encoding_format base64: padded standard base64 of little-endian float32 values (four bytes per dimension).

EmbeddingUsage.description: Input tokens only (total equals prompt); there are no completion tokens and no monetary field.

FileErrorEnvelope.description: Files API error (protocols/files.rs): param names the offending field, or is null. The exhaustive code list is documented with the Files operations.

b64_json.description: A complete PNG, JPEG or WebP image, base64-validated by the gateway.

ImageUsage.description: Observed counters only; total_tokens only when both are known.

created.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch the catalog entry was created.

id.description: The public model name to send as `model`.

JobErrorCode.description: Code of a job error: not_found plus the JobError::{Conflict,Invalid,Forbidden} literals scanned from src/jobs.

JobErrorEnvelope.description: Job (video and batch) error: 404 and 400 are invalid_request_error, 403 permission_error (protocols/videos.rs job_error). Inference errors of a job route use OpenAiErrorEnvelope.

OpenAiErrorCode.description: Gateway machine code, generated from InferenceError::code over every variant plus the transport codes of OPENAI_TRANSPORT. Clients branch on this, never on the message.

OpenAiErrorEnvelope.description: OpenAI-shaped inference error. Never the management ErrorEnvelope: error.code is a gateway machine code, not the HTTP status, and there is no error.reason.

OpenAiErrorType.description: OpenAI error.type. Generated from the renderers: budget denials are insufficient_quota, token-reservation and job-limit denials rate_limit_error, a cooling route server_error, every other InferenceError uses its code as its type, plus the transport kinds of OPENAI_TRANSPORT.

info.description: INCOMPLETE contract (#82 PR1): the operations of areas models, embeddings, rerank, systemone, images and the two realtime refusals are complete and wire-validated against the real handlers; every other operation is an explicit, counted placeholder. Every operation authenticates with an inference key only (Bearer; /v1/messages also accepts x-api-key, GET /v1/realtime also the openai-insecure-api-key.<key> WebSocket subprotocol, never both); inference keys never authorize management and admin tokens never authorize inference. Live key, workspace, catalog and budget checks remain authoritative. The OpenAI-shaped, Anthropic-shaped, job and file error envelopes are distinct schemas and never the management ErrorEnvelope; /v1/messages errors carry no gateway machine code. x-omg-* extensions state what OpenAPI 3.1 cannot express (see docs/openapi/inference/README.md).
info.title: Open Model Gateway inference API

post.description: String-only, non-streaming embeddings (protocols/embeddings.rs). Embeddings are an input-only workload: usage never has completion tokens. A capability no deployment supports is 501 unsupported_capability (not the 400 of the other workloads). Oversized bodies: the shared 2 MiB cap. Streamed oversized bodies return the shared 413 JSON envelope: type invalid_request_error, code payload_too_large, message Request body too large (#432).
